title: Exploration Delegation Prompt
description: Scoped exploration with partitioned targets. The spawner defines what this agent explores, what peers cover, and what essential outputs are required. Use when multiple exploration agents work in parallel on different facets of a codebase or system.

type.description: Delegation type. Use 'exploration' when spawning scoped exploration sub-agents with partitioned targets.

task.description: What the delegate should explore. One clear sentence.

file_coordinates.description: Absolute file paths with line numbers.

exploration_scope.description: What this agent explores and how it relates to peers. Required for exploration delegation.

primary_targets.description: Specific categories or areas this agent must explore. Not vague topics -- specific, bounded targets.

peer_scopes.description: What other parallel agents cover. Prevents overlap and enables cross_scope_findings.

extension_policy.description: Conditions under which the agent can extend beyond primary_targets. E.g., 'Only extend if a primary target depends on an external module not covered by peers.'

essential_output.description: What the agent MUST deliver with high confidence. Each item is a specific deliverable the parent expects.

return_schema.description: The JSON schema the sub-agent's return must match. Included in the prompt so the sub-agent knows the expected format.

return_instruction.description: Instruction text telling the sub-agent to output only JSON matching return_schema.
return_instruction.default: Your final output MUST be a single JSON object matching return_schema. No text outside the JSON. Include delegation_type field set to 'exploration'.
